# 1,000.00 USD of income paid into A at 1.40, taking it from −500.00 to
# +500.00 in one split.
#
# The first 500.00 repays what A owes, drawn from A's owed cost basis at 1.35:
# 675.00 of cost. The other 500.00 arrives on the held side, and opens a cost
# basis on the same split at the 1.40 it came in at: 700.00. So the split is
# valued at 675.00 + 700.00 = 1,375.00 against the 1,400.00 of income, and
# `$residual$` takes the 25.00 lost on repaying at 1.40 a debt taken on at
# 1.35.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-02-01 * "1,000.00 USD of income paid into A"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD A 1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "11/8"
		value: "1375.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000001"
	Income:Consulting -1400.00 CAD
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
